Type one coin, or several separated by commas to rotate them, or to fill a heatmap below.
Heatmap Grid shows every coin above as one color-coded grid instead of rotating through them. Timeframe, sparkline, holdings and alerts below don't apply in this mode.
Holdings (optional)
Fill both to show your position's profit/loss on the key.
Alerts (optional)
No API key needed. Type any coin in the custom field. Press a key to cycle timeframe.
